name: CEC2014 Benchmark Functions Dataset
description: The CEC2014 suite of benchmark optimization functions used to evaluate optimization algorithms on standardized test problems.
evaluation_method: best objective value (fitness) achieved / error to known optimum (function value at fixed budget)
general_score_metric: best objective value (fitness) / error to known optimum
reputation: Widely used standard benchmark suite in the evolutionary computation and numerical optimization communities for comparing optimization algorithms.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark of synthetic optimization functions; commonly used for algorithm comparison and may be vulnerable to overfitting/tuning to the specific function set. Results typically reported as function value vs. evaluation budget or convergence curves.

institutions: IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC) organizing committee / associated contributors
